title: Pure Jinzo
summary: Jinzo monsters and the cards that name Jinzo, with generic staples. The page's combo line runs the Dark Time Wizard cards from the same set, which this list leaves out. Without them, Jinzo - Energy Shocker, the newest card, still wipes the opponent's Traps when summoned and counts as Jinzo on the field and in the GY, and a second copy on your field or in your GY turns its Trap lock on. Psychic Bounder and Jinzo - Jector find the Jinzo monsters, and Psychic Wave puts Jinzo in the GY for Jinzo the Machine Menace to bring back.
main: Jinzo - Energy Shocker
Newest support. Summoned: destroys every Trap the opponent controls; a second copy on your field or in your GY locks their Traps.
Jinzo
The original: no Trap can be activated, and Trap effects on the field are negated.
Jinzo the Machine Menace
Summons itself while a Trap is face-up or in a GY; tributes itself to bring back Jinzo and clear their Traps.
Psychic Bounder
Summoned: searches Jinzo or a Spell/Trap that names it.
Jinzo - Jector
Counts as Jinzo; tributes itself to search a Jinzo monster and summons more if they have Set Traps.
Psychic Megacyber
Summons itself when the opponent has more Spells/Traps; a Level 6 for Jinzo - Layered.
Jinzo - Returner
Sent to the GY: revives Jinzo for the turn.
Jinzo - Lord
Summoned by sending a face-up Jinzo to the GY: locks Traps and burns for each one it destroys.
Psychic Wave
Sends Jinzo from the Deck to the GY; later recycles a Machine from the GY.
Law of the Cosmos
Summons Jinzo from the Deck if the opponent Sets a Trap, or searches a Jinzo card if they don't.
Cyber Energy Shock
With Jinzo out: destroys a card, and negates another or boosts Jinzo if it was a Trap.
Everlasting Alloy
With Jinzo out: protects your Machines from destruction or negates a targeting effect.
extra: Rank 6 for two Level 6s: borrows an opposing monster and destroys a face-up card while a Trap is on the field.
